human_check_steps:
On this Mac (`npx wrangler d1 migrations apply ticker --local`, then `npm run dev` in `/Users/wanghui/coding/ticker`):

1. Open http://localhost:5173 and click "Sign in to make your lists".
2. Enter any email address and click "Email me a sign-in link": the page says to check your
   email; on this Mac no email is sent, and the link is in the terminal running `npm run dev`
   (a line starting `[sign-in link for ...]`).
3. Open that link and click "Sign in": you are back on the home page, with a round account
   button at the top right.
4. Open the same link again: it says the link does not work (each link works once).
5. Click the account button, then "Sign out".
Real emails are checked on the live site in v0.3.
